summary:
Strict coordinate-based geolocation and geohash isolation between cities (such as Chennai and Puducherry):
- Multi-source GPS location engine resolving actual device GPS coordinates with fallback across FusedLocation and LocationManager providers.
- Guarded Firestore queries that immediately reject empty/blank geohash prefixes, preventing collection-wide data leakage.
- Strict physical Haversine coordinate distance filtering in NearGridViewModel ensuring only posts and broadcasts within the selected discovery radius (default 1,000m, max 10,000m) are visible.
- Verified coordinate isolation between Chennai (~13.08°N) and Puducherry (~11.94°N) (~135km apart) with unit test coverage.
- UI guard preventing posting broadcasts or community needs/offers without a valid non-zero GPS lock.
